# Design Artifact Template

Write to `.qa/design/<feature-slug>.md` at end of pingpong-solution session.

```markdown
# Design: <human-readable title>

<!-- generated by /pingpong-solution on YYYY-MM-DD -->

## Problem & Intent
<confirmed restatement>

## Non-Goals
- …

## Assumptions
- …

## Options Considered

### Option A: <name> (recommended | rejected)
- Summary: …
- Pros: …
- Cons: …
- Evidence: …

### Option B: <name>
…

### Option C: <name> (optional)
…

## Decision
**Chosen:** Option A  
**Why:** …

## Cross-Domain Sign-Off
| Domain | Status | Note |
|--------|--------|------|
| KISS | ✅ | … |
| SOLID | ✅ | … |
| DRY | ✅ | … |
| Security | ✅ | … |
| UI/UX | ⚠️ | … |
| Scaling | ✅ | … |
| Testability | ✅ | … |
| Maintainability | ✅ | … |

## Confidence
**XX%** — see criteria in session summary

## Implementation Sketch
```
paths/
  …
```
- New dependencies: none | …
- Estimated scope: ~N lines
- Tests: unit | verify-ui | both

## Open Questions
- [ ] …

## Ready for /implement
YES | NO — …
```

## Slug rules

Same as implement acceptance: kebab-case, max 48 chars, from feature name or branch.

## Handoff to /implement

`/implement` Step 0 reads this file first when slug matches:

- **Intent** → acceptance Intent
- **Decision + Sketch** → Happy Path + Implementation scope
- **Cross-Domain + Open Questions** → Edge Cases + Assumptions
- **Non-Goals** → guardrails for minimal diff
